players.product: Optical connectors and components for data centers (Intelli-Cross Pro data-center optical connectors, ferrules, MT fiber arrays for optical transceivers), optical connector polishing machines and end-face inspection equipment

quarterly_data.quarter: Seikoh Giken results briefing Q&A: FY2026 results briefing Q&A (05-22-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Management (results briefing Q&A, FY ended March 2026 briefing held May 19, 2026): lead times for optical connector polishing machines and end-face inspection equipment, normally about 2 months, have stretched to about half a year; orders come when customers decide to add optical connector production lines, so the demand the company can see through its customers runs about half a year ahead, and some major customers give an indication of their next order before the machines already ordered are fully delivered. Management says market-wide demand for optical fiber, optical connectors and the polishing and measuring equipment the company supplies continues to exceed production; it expects each market participant to add capacity in the fiscal year ending March 2027 but says it cannot quantify the supply-demand gap or say whether it will narrow or widen. The company plans to increase polishing machine and measuring equipment production capacity this fiscal year.
quarterly_data.figure: Polishing machine / inspection equipment lead time about half a year vs normally about 2 months

quarterly_data.quarter: Seikoh Giken results briefing Q&A: FY2026 results briefing Q&A (05-22-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Management on demand shifts (results briefing Q&A): optical connector polishing machine inquiries were strong from North American customers through the first half of the fiscal year ended March 2026, but in the second half the market shifted to Chinese customers, whose demand remains strong; orders since the second half have increased from the China plants of North American customers and from Chinese customers. Management says the customer base is returning to the diverse mix of customers worldwide it had before data-center demand took off. In optical communication components, inquiries for optical modules other than the Intelli-Cross PRO data-center connector have been increasing, and management says the overall optical communication market remains buoyant on the increase in data centers.

quarterly_data.quarter: Seikoh Giken results briefing Q&A: FY2026 results briefing Q&A (05-22-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Management on the fiscal year ended March 2026 (results briefing Q&A): end-of-period rush shipments of high value-added machines and equipment, while sales of optical communication components fell short of plan, improved the product mix, which management cites as one of the factors that lifted Q4 profit above the forecast; customer requests to bring forward deliveries of optical connector polishing machines and measuring equipment and the yen's weakening at year end also made Q4 significantly stronger. Subsidiary MG Co. (made a subsidiary during the fiscal year ended March 2025) contributed sales of just under JPY 4 hundred million in the prior year (Q4 only) and just under JPY 17 hundred million in the fiscal year ended March 2026, a year-on-year sales increase of about JPY 13 hundred million.
quarterly_data.figure: MG Co. sales just under JPY 17 hundred million vs just under JPY 4 hundred million; increase about JPY 13 hundred million

quarterly_data.quarter: Seikoh Giken results briefing Q&A: FY2026 results briefing Q&A (05-22-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Management on the May 2026 forecast for the fiscal year ending March 2027 (results briefing Q&A): the guidance excludes the prior year's special factors (Q4 front-loaded deliveries and year-end yen weakness) and is built on the order backlog, so it is below the prior second-half run rate. Products made on the new equipment announced on May 14, 2026 need customer certification before mass production, which takes time, so their sales are expected to contribute meaningfully from the following fiscal year onward. On pricing, management says it is not currently considering price increases because pricing against competitors matters; it aims to keep prices and shorten lead times instead.

quarterly_data.quarter: Seikoh Giken results briefing Q&A: FY2026 results briefing Q&A (05-22-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Management on competitive position (results briefing Q&A): the company sees itself as a total supplier that sells both optical connector polishing machines (part of customers' manufacturing equipment) and optical connectors, MT fiber arrays and modules. It sees its edge in fiber 'alignment' technology (its fiber array aligns the cores of 24 optical fibers), is working on automating alignment, and will set out business plans using it in the next medium-term management plan now being drafted. The Intelli-Cross PRO data-center connector uses a flat, easy-to-detach design for tight data-center spaces; the company does drawing, mold-making, molding, assembly and mass production in-house, which management says lets it go from concept to mass production faster than others; MT fiber array strengths include precise alignment and in-house guide pins for MT ferrule positioning. On polishing machines management says the competitive landscape has not changed much and its share would change if it could expand capacity further.
